name: Minecraft, a supervised local server
summary: Runs a bounded agent episode in a local vanilla Minecraft server. The host boots the world, the mc-bridge bot joins it as an offline player, and the agent works under the action and wall-clock bounds the world manifest declares.

refuses.name: missing_prerequisites
refuses.explanation: An episode needs three things built or fetched ahead of time — the mc-bridge helper, the server jar for the manifest's Minecraft version, and a Java runtime — and the runner names the missing one rather than substituting a different world or a remote server.
